description: Default mesh classifications plus individually map-reviewed overrides. A mesh name does not establish road surface: both gravel and Asphalt_Road_02 assets appear on white paved roads and grey tracks.

overrideEvidence.review: Candidate curves overlaid on the exposed map and visually checked; surface changes do not alter topology or authorize water crossings.
manualReviews: Z4 yellow-road lighthouse approach, including complete curved road segments with raster-registration error exceeding the automatic candidate threshold.
